name: Bubble de House de OOO ~Ofuro Maker no Showroom ga Sharehouse de...~
original_name: バブルdeハウスde〇〇〇 〜お風呂メーカーのショールームがシェアハウスで…〜
source: Protagonist, a student, moves into a share house that offers discounted rent in exchange for monitoring a famous bath manufacturer's products. He had thought he didn't get the opportunity, but to his surprise, he's accepted at the last minute. After moving in, he realizes that all the other residents are female upperclassmen from the same school. It's time for some heart-pounding, bath-filled, crazy student life with those ladies!
translation: 主角是一名学生，搬进了一间合租屋。作为入住条件，他需要监测一家知名浴室设备制造商的产品，并因此享受租金优惠。他原以为自己不会有机会入住，没想到最后一刻竟获准加入。搬进去后他才发现，其他住户全是同一所学校的女学姐。一段令人心跳加速、充满浴室戏码的疯狂校园生活就此展开！
